From the plant area at the bottom there is an arrow pointing to the rabbit, indicating that the rabbit eats plants. Reasoning: The question asks what kind of plant life consumer the bunny is in this diagram. Animals that eat plants or producers belong to primary consumers; the rabbit in the image is also directly labeled "Primary Consumers." Therefore the answer is primary.
